### T5. Cold strategy

- Preconditioning (R7, below 0 C): 8.0 kW into the plates; -10 C to +10 C in 8.3 min, 1.11 kWh electrical from the genset.
- Cold-soaked (unpreconditioned) LTO at -10 C accepts 67.0 kW continuous at the bus = 77.4 kW at the wheel - above the 75 kW cap. The WS1 4.15 cold case (regen disabled) does not occur with this chemistry.
- V1 genset average, cold, 4 kW aux: WS1 assumption 15.0 kW (+48%); with LTO acceptance 12.11 kW (+20% with WS1's warm 0.97 scalars) / 12.55 kW (+24% with the cold resistance model in the loop, WS3-r1-F3) - headline +20-25%. Friction-brake energy on VOLT-SUB stays 0.29 kWh instead of 3.61 kWh.
- Dispatch gates: full 120 kW discharge from cell T >= -5.5 C; full 110 kW charge from 0.0 C; 50 kW continuous descent charge available over the whole R7 envelope including -10 C cold soak. Gates are computed against the 432.0 V pack floor = the exported operating_min_V; a higher WS2 electronics floor derates them per T12 (WS3-r1-F1).

Reading: the 1.50 V/cell row IS the exported window - operating_min_V 432.0 V and the -5.5 C gate are computed against the same floor, so window and gates are jointly satisfiable. Round 1's 532.8 V operating_min_V (an undocumented 1.85 V/cell allocation) is retained as the 1.85 row: enforcing it as a hard floor moves the 120 kW gate from -5.5 C to +9.0 C. Operating points: 120 kW warm (25 C, SOC 40) = 210 A at 571.8 V; at the cold gate = 274 A at 437.5 V; warm at SOC 15 the bus sits at 527.7 V (full power below SOC 40 is not guaranteed - WS5 dispatch limit). Charge side: the 110 kW pulse at its +0.0 C gate rides the bus to 776.4 V - above the 748.8 V continuous ceiling, inside the 777.6 V transient/protect ceiling.

252s end of the offered series range (exact, not interpolated): 13.33 kWh nameplate, nominal 579.6 V, window 378.0-655.2 V (transient 680.4 V); the gates move WARMER - 120 kW discharge from -1.5 C, 110 kW charge from +4.5 C - and warm 120 kW current rises to 245 A (490.5 V), reaching 314 A (381.9 V) at its own gate.
